standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: El Portal "minutes" are verbatim transcripts (Full Moon Creative) without item numbers at each vote. Rolls were matched to agenda items by address or keyword and by agenda order; matched rolls carry a note and should be checked against the meeting video. Where the match failed, roll is null
No minutes posted for 2025-11-18, 2025-12-09, 2026-03-24 or 2026-09-22; private-party agenda items from those meetings are listed with roll null
Meeting URLs point to the village meetings page with the file name as a fragment; the PDFs sit under wp-content/uploads/<year>/<month>/
Planning & Zoning board minutes (2025-01-21, 03-20, 06-24, 07-09, 10-28, 2026-01-22, 07-30) are a separate board and were not counted as council actions

Excluded under the standard: Miami-Dade interlocal agreements (legal notices, recycling), speed humps, advisory boards, landscaper/asphalt proposals that name no vendor, FOP police contract, village manager hiring and contract, elections and millage
Consent agenda (including the Osuna Ornamental Fences proposal) passed 3-0 but the transcript does not identify the three voters; roll null
